verdict.rationale: Browserbase's docs explicitly describe programmatic session creation/control, full browser automation, 30+ starter templates, and deploying/running agents 'on a schedule or on demand' without infrastructure management, directly matching the story of building and deploying custom scraping scripts serverlessly. Missing for 10: independent developer testimonials confirming ease of deploying custom scripts, and detailed docs/tutorials specifically on writing/deploying custom scraping code (vs. general agent framing).
